labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: heading
labels.value: Accounting Export

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: what it does
labels.value: Download the gifts in a date range as a spreadsheet for your accounting system: one row for each fund a gift went to, and refunds as negative rows on the day the money went back.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: the file holds visible gifts
labels.value: The file holds the gifts you can see. If gifts in your organization are private, the person who runs the export needs to see all of them.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: start date field
labels.value: From

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: end date field
labels.value: To

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: fund field
labels.value: Fund

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: fund left empty
labels.value: All funds

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: payment method field
labels.value: Payment method

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: payment method left empty
labels.value: All payment methods

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: download button
labels.value: Download file

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: what the file holds
labels.value: {0} rows from {1} gifts. Net total {2}.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export page: nothing in the range
labels.value: No gifts in this range.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export: a date is missing
labels.value: Choose a From date and a To date.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export: dates in the wrong order
labels.value: The To date is before the From date.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export: over the row limit
labels.value: More than 10,000 rows in this range. Choose a shorter range, or one fund.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export: the fund is not a fund
labels.value: Choose a fund from the list.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export: the method is not allowed
labels.value: Choose a payment method from the list.

labels.shortDescription: Export refused: no Accounting Export permission set
labels.value: The accounting export needs the Accounting Export permission set. Ask your BarnCRM admin for it.

labels.shortDescription: Accounting export: unexpected failure
labels.value: The export could not be produced. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Only unposted gifts checkbox
labels.value: Only gifts not yet posted

labels.shortDescription: Mark posted button
labels.value: Mark these gifts posted

labels.shortDescription: Mark posted help
labels.value: Once this file is in your accounting system, mark its gifts posted. A posted gift cannot be changed or deleted.

labels.shortDescription: Gifts marked posted
labels.value: Marked {0} gifts posted. Gifts already posted were left as they were.

labels.shortDescription: Marking needs all funds
labels.value: To mark gifts posted, download the export for all funds: a gift split across funds would be locked when only part of it is in this file.

labels.shortDescription: Gifts changed since download
labels.value: Gifts in this range changed since you downloaded the file, so nothing was marked. Download the file again, import it, and then mark.
